title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Metagauss…
description: An SQL Injection vulnerability exists in Metagauss ProfileGrid plugin versions up to and including 6.0.0.6. This flaw allows an attacker with low privileges and no user interaction to execute unauthorized SQL commands, potentially leading to high confidentiality impact and limited availability impact. The vulnerability is publicly known and rated with a high severity score of 8.5.
